primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'δ_θ': 'angular divergence in radians', 'o': 'player orientation in radians', 'Dir': 'direction vector in radians'}
primitives.assumptions: Player facing direction is aligned with movement direction; angular wrapping ensures continuity.
